description: This file defines a set of React components for a navigation menu UI, utilizing Radix UI primitives and custom styling. It includes components such as NavigationMenu, NavigationMenuList, NavigationMenuTrigger, and others, with styling and behavior for a dropdown navigation menu.

methods.name: NavigationMenu
methods.description: A React component that renders the root of the navigation menu, forwarding refs and combining class names.

methods.name: NavigationMenuList
methods.description: A React component that renders the list container for menu items, forwarding refs and applying styles.

methods.name: NavigationMenuTrigger
methods.description: A React component that acts as a trigger for opening submenus, including an icon indicator.

methods.name: NavigationMenuContent
methods.description: A React component that renders the content area of the navigation menu, with animation and positioning styles.

methods.name: NavigationMenuViewport
methods.description: A React component that renders the viewport for the menu, handling positioning and animation.

methods.name: NavigationMenuIndicator
methods.description: A React component that renders an indicator element for active or open states.
